title: Recursive Agent Harnessing & Propose-Probe-Compose Architecture

claims.assertion: Task-level recursion refines execution harnesses via contrastive Propose-Probe-Compose steps over orthogonal INV and DOM dimensions without modifying LLM weights.
claims.evidence_quote: Harness2 is a plug-and-play framework for recursive agent harnessing in an open world... Task-level recursion refines the execution harness for the current task through a contrastive Propose-Probe-Compose step: propose edits, probe their effects on the same task, and compose a refined harness from behavioral contrasts between executions, without ground-truth feedback.

claims.assertion: Strict budget accounting enforces R=4k rollouts and P=3k improvement sessions per mode, checking duplicate run labels before count evaluation.
Editable harness surfaces must autotrigger skills in always-on context and validate all constraints in a single pass returning actionable feedback.
Blind selection evaluates anonymized candidate artifacts with stable seeded shuffled IDs, dropping non-answers and falling back neutrally upon selector failure.
Harnessing-level recursion updates a persistent per-domain experience library with full adopted trees only when supported by cue, lesson, and evidence triples.
Evidence isolation tripwires scan in-flight context and harness trees for evaluator verdicts and answer-key leaks, failing closed before model submission.
